title: Surreal Gathering Under Eclipse
description: A surreal scene depicts five people in a dimly lit room with a large table covered in food, books, and objects. In the dramatic sky above, a giant glowing orange moon dominates a swirling vortex, with a floating figure, orbiting spheres, and a large black bird flying through clouds of smoke.
prompt: Surreal scene of five people gathered around a table with food, books, and objects in a dark room. A massive glowing orange moon with swirling vortex and orbiting spheres fills the dramatic sky. A nude figure floats near the moon while a large black bird flies through white and orange clouds of smoke. Cinematic lighting, rich textures, symbolic and mysterious atmosphere.
